## What's New in 1.2.1

The embedded SEMPv2 OpenAPI specs now match the 10.26.11 rolling release, and `golang.org/x/net` is updated to fix two vulnerabilities.

Full details are in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SolaceProducts/solace-broker-mcp/blob/v1.2.1/CHANGELOG.md).

### Changed

- The embedded SEMPv2 OpenAPI specs match the 10.26.11 rolling release, so tool schemas include current event broker attributes.

### Security

- `golang.org/x/net` is now v0.62.0 (was v0.61.0), fixing CVE-2026-78661 (high) and CVE-2026-97045 (medium).
